title: Hermes Test Case Generation Result - Spike

scopeNote.description: Coverage boundary statement supplied by the Agent. The control plane preserves it as submitted.

totalCount.description: Optional producer-supplied display statistic. The control plane does not recalculate or rewrite it.

p0Count.description: Optional producer-supplied display statistic; not recalculated by the control plane.

p1Count.description: Optional producer-supplied display statistic; not recalculated by the control plane.

p2Count.description: Optional producer-supplied display statistic; not recalculated by the control plane.

boundaryCount.description: Optional producer-supplied display statistic; not recalculated by the control plane.

exceptionCount.description: Optional producer-supplied display statistic; not recalculated by the control plane.

customHeaders.description: Suggested Excel headers. Defaults to 用例编号, 一级模块, 二级模块, 用例标题, 测试类型, 优先级, 前置条件, 操作步骤, 测试数据, 预期结果 when missing or empty.

moduleSummaries.description: Per first-level module subtotals. The service derives them from items when missing or empty.

test_case_files.description: Assembled TEST_CASE pack. Keys are relative POSIX paths (README.md, data/catalog.json, modules/*.json). Historical results may omit this field and only carry items.

items.description: Case list assembled from modules/*.json (or legacy single-JSON submit). No fixed item cap; coverage depth follows quality mode.

caseId.description: Case number such as TC-M01-001. The producer should submit the canonical caseId field; compatibility aliases are not rewritten.

module.description: First-level module. The producer should submit the canonical module field; compatibility aliases are only read for validation.

subModule.description: Second-level module supplied by the producer. The control plane does not synthesize it.

title.description: Case title. The producer should submit the canonical title field; compatibility aliases are not rewritten.

type.description: Canonical test type supplied by the producer. The control plane does not normalize synonyms.

priority.description: Canonical priority supplied by the producer. The control plane does not normalize synonyms.

precondition.description: Precondition supplied by the producer. The control plane does not synthesize a default.

steps.description: Operation steps supplied by the producer. Arrays are preserved as arrays.

testData.description: Test data supplied by the producer. The control plane does not synthesize a placeholder.

expectedResult.description: Expected result. The producer should submit the canonical expectedResult field; compatibility aliases are only read for validation.

description.description: Design focus of the case, rendered as 设计关注点/说明 in Excel.
